waiting.label: Waiting
waiting.description: Waits until all predecessors are done.

queued.label: Queued
queued.description: The run has been created and starts shortly.

failed.label: Error
failed.description: Failed. The error message is in the details; the steps after it are blocked.

skipped.label: Skipped
skipped.description: Not run because this branch was not chosen. This is not an error.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Ended by cancelling or by an incomplete trace.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Not run because a predecessor failed or was cancelled.

awaiting_approval.label: Awaiting approval
awaiting_approval.description: A person has to approve or reject; the run waits until then.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: The run waits for an approval and continues after the decision.
